- Are the 40 GPUs A100-equivalent (heavy generative inference) or a mix with A800-like nodes?
- Target 95th pctl latency/throughput you want to preserve at peak?
- Do you need the added capacity to be dedicated to a single team or shared across multiple services?

Preliminary ballpark (subject to verification):
- Option A: +40 A100-equivalent GPUs added to your pool -> $3,400 / GPU / month list; 18% discount for a 12-month commit on the uplift, deeper discounts for 24 months.
- Option B: +24 A800-equivalent GPUs -> $2,900 / GPU / month list; 15% discount for 12-month commit.

I'll pull Jonas in for sizing guidance and Karthik for contractual items (billing cadence, amendment approach). If you want, we can do a 30-minute technical + commercial call tomorrow.

I'll attach a mutual action plan template (BrightScale_MAPlan_v1.xlsx) and follow up with a formal quote PDF this week.

- Hannah

On Fri, Jul 2, 2026 at 11:05 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> Preliminary ballpark...

Alex, quick technical read on the attachment and options:

- The Q2 usage profile shows many short-lived high-concurrency bursts (chat-heavy). For that pattern, continuous batching + more smaller nodes tends to give better tail latency.

Recommended configurations:
- Config 1 (throughput-focused): add 40 A100-equivalent GPUs to your existing pool. Expected baseline throughput +65% at median; preserves 95th pctl latency within 10% of current SLAs with our batching settings.
- Config 2 (cost/latency tradeoff): add 28 A800-equivalent GPUs (higher memory/efficiency) — ~+48% throughput, 12% better price/per-token in typical chat LLMs.

Operational notes:
- We can stage the uplift: 50% in Aug, 50% in Sep to reduce ramp risk.
- Throughput guarantee can be scoped at route level (e.g., /generate only) and backed by credits on missed SLOs.

Happy to run a short perf sim against your June traces if you want concrete token/sec numbers.

— Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
